program_name: Economics, Management and Finance - Economics and Management for Innovation and Sustainability
teaching_language: fully English (curriculum-specific: this is one of three curricula within the LM-77 'Economics, Management and Finance' programme; the other two curricula, 'Management, consulenza e controllo aziendale' and 'Finanza', are taught in Italian)
campus: Viterbo. Department: Economics, Engineering, Society and Business Organization (DEIM - Dipartimento di Economia, Ingegneria, Società e Impresa)
degree_class: LM-77 [uncertain] - the outline task brief listed this as 'LM-76', but the official unitus.it program page and its didactic regulation PDF both unambiguously state 'LM-77'. This appears to be a mix-up in the source task with the separate 'Circular Economy' programme, which IS degree class LM-76. Reported here as LM-77 per the primary source.
academic_requirements: Bachelor's degree (laurea triennale) or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad and recognized as suitable is required to enter the LM-77 programme generally. The 2025-updated didactic regulation for the parent LM-77 course (Amministrazione, Finanza e Controllo) specifies: direct access for graduates of classes L-18 or L-33; graduates of other bachelor's classes (or holders of an equivalent foreign qualification, or of an old-system 4-year laurea) must additionally hold at least 36 CFU distributed as: 6-12 CFU in SSD SECS-P/01 or SECS-P/02; 6-12 CFU in SSD SECS-P/07 or SECS-P/11; 6-12 CFU in SSD IUS/01 or IUS/04; 6-12 CFU in SSD SECS-S/01, SECS-S/03 or SECS-S/06. Any curricular gap ('carenze formative') must be filled before the course starts. The programme is 'ad accesso libero' (open access): adequacy of personal preparation is verified via the candidate's CV/academic history, possibly supplemented by an interview. [uncertain] The 2025 didactic regulation PDF (the most recent one found, dated 02.10.2025) describes only the two Italian-taught curricula (Amministrazione e Controllo, Finanza) and does NOT mention the English-taught 'Economics and Management for Innovation and Sustainability' curriculum at all - it is unclear whether this English curriculum is governed by the same 36-CFU/SSD thresholds or has its own (unpublished) academic prerequisites; this could not be confirmed on unitus.it.
language_requirements: English proficiency at CEFR B2 level is required ('English language proficiency at least at B2 level', per the official programme page), consistent with the university-wide baseline (accepted certificates: IELTS, TOEFL, TCL, Cambridge First, PTE Academic, Oxford Test of English, Aptis ESOL General/Advanced, or documentation of a prior EMI degree). No Italian language requirement is stated for this English-taught curriculum. [uncertain] No curriculum-specific numeric score table (e.g. minimum IELTS/TOEFL score) was found on unitus.it for this programme; only the general B2 threshold is stated.
entry_exam_or_test: Enrolment is subject to verification of curricular requirements and adequate personal preparation. For international students specifically, admission requires completion of a mandatory 'Oral interview' (per the official programme page: 'For international students only: Oral interview'). For students holding a qualification obtained abroad or under previous Italian academic systems, the Degree Programme Board verifies curricular requirements through an evaluation of the applicant's prior academic career. No TOLC, no numerus clausus/bando. [uncertain] No further detail (format, dates, topics, online vs in-person, scoring threshold) specific to this curriculum is published on unitus.it; the interview is presumably booked via the university-wide Interview Booking form.
application_deadline_eu: No programme-specific application deadline is published on the official unitus.it program page (admission is rolling, gated by curricular verification and the oral interview for international students, not a call/bando). University-wide 2026/2027 enrolment calendar applies: enrolment opens 2026-08-01, deadline for 1st-year Master's students 2026-12-29, with extension to 2027-02-28 for January/February graduates.
application_deadline_non_eu: No programme-specific deadline published. University-wide 2026/2027 calendar applies: non-EU visa application cutoff at the consulate is 2026-11-30; onsite enrolment via the International Students Desk opens 2026-08-01; Universitaly pre-enrolment is open for a.y. 2026/2027 (Universitaly itself typically opens around April/May).
required_documents: [uncertain] No programme-specific required-documents list was found on unitus.it for this curriculum; the following is inferred from the university-wide required_documents_baseline (outline.yaml) rather than a programme-specific source
Prior degree diploma (laurea triennale or equivalent) + full transcript, certified copy + Apostille/legalization + certified Italian translation OR CIMEA Statement of Verification
Declaration of Value (Dichiarazione di Valore) OR CIMEA Statement of Comparability OR ARDI Statement of Correspondence (for foreign qualifications)
Diploma Supplement (can substitute the Declaration of Value if legalized)
English language certificate (B2) or EMI documentation
Completed interview booking (for international students, via the university-wide Interview Booking form)

tuition_or_fees_link.note: General UNITUS fees page. ISEEUP income-based tiered tuition for EU/assimilated students; non-EU students without an ISEEUP declaration pay a flat fee based on a 4-tier country band (EUR 600 / 1,050 / 1,500 / 1,950 per year, per Annex 1 of the 2026/2027 tuition regulations). No curriculum-specific fee figure was found.

source_quotes.quote: Economics, Management and Finance – Economics and Management for Innovation and Sustainability / LM-77
Headquarter: Viterbo / Department: Economics, Engineering Society and Business Organization

The "Economics and Management for Innovation and Sustainability" curriculum is one of three tracks within the LM-77 Master's Degree Program in Economics, Management, and Finance and is taught entirely in English.
Enrollment is subject to verification of curricular requirements. For international students only: Oral interview.
Enrollment is in any case subject to verification of curricular requirements, adequate personal preparation, and English language proficiency at least at B2 level.

Per l'accesso al corso è richiesta la laurea triennale nelle classi L-18 o L-33. [...] purché in possesso dei seguenti requisiti curriculari (almeno 36 CFU) [...] da 6 a 12 CFU nel SSD SECS-P/01 o SSD SECS-P/02; da 6 a 12 CFU nel SSD SECS-P/07 o SECS-P/11; da 6 a 12 CFU nel SSD IUS/01 o IUS/04; da 6 a 12 CFU nel SSD SECS-S/01 o SECS-S/03 o SECS-S/06.

Il corso di laurea magistrale è ad accesso libero. L'adeguatezza della personale preparazione viene verificata sulla base del curriculum vitae et studiorum dello studente, eventualmente integrato da un colloquio.
No programme-specific deadline published on unitus.it; university-wide calendar: enrolment 2026-08-01 to 2026-12-29 for 1st-year Master's (per shared_admission_baseline / official_calendar_2026_2027)
No programme-specific deadline published on unitus.it; university-wide non-EU visa cutoff 2026-11-30 (per shared_admission_baseline / official_calendar_2026_2027)
